## Checklist

- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy` and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] New or changed behavior is covered by tests
- [ ] Public items are documented; README updated if user-facing behavior changed
- [ ] Breaking changes are marked with `!` in the PR title
